title: Credit and Allowance Authority on a Northbeam Purchase Order
content:
1. Where the goods miss the promised day by more than the fulfilment service's grace days, the service's late delivery
   credit is paid. It is paid once per order rather than once per day.
2. Cosmetic transit damage the customer chooses to accept is met with the fulfilment service's damage allowance
   percentage of the line. Damage the customer does not accept is a refusal instead.
3. A goodwill credit is granted for the inconvenience the retailer caused, is recorded as goodwill, and does not become
   a standing entitlement.
4. Credits are applied to the order line they arise on, and several credits on one line are added together up to the
   value of the line and never beyond it.

This is the authority the desk works to on every order under Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment.

## The grace figure read on both sides (hypothetical days)

The late credit is paid where the goods miss the promised day by more than the grace days. On a service whose grace
stands at 1 day, goods handed over one day after the promised day have not missed it by more than the grace days, while
goods handed over two days after have. On a service whose grace stands at 2 days, two days late is not more than the
grace days and three days late is. However many days late the goods are beyond that point, the credit is paid once on
the order.

## The line cap worked through (hypothetical amounts)

Two credits arise on one line whose value is 500.00, one of 300.00 and one of 400.00. Added together they come to
700.00, which stands above the value of the line, so the total credited on that line is 500.00 and never beyond it.
Where the same two credits arose on a line whose value is 900.00, the total credited would be the 700.00 they come to.

## Points of judgement

**Cosmetic transit damage the customer will not accept: what is it?** A refusal, rather than an allowance.

**Does a goodwill credit granted once have to be granted again?** No. It is recorded as goodwill and does not become a
standing entitlement.

**Can credits on one line exceed the value of that line?** No. They are added together up to the value of the line and
never beyond it.
